title.zh: 授予Rhode E. Yonzon女士在西内格罗斯Calatrava市镇建设、维护与运营电灯、热力与动力系统的特许经营权的法案
title.en: An Act Granting Mrs. Rhode E. Yonzon a Franchise to Construct, Maintain and Operate An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Calatrava, Negros Occidental
title.orig: An Act Granting Mrs. Rhode E. Yonzon a Franchise to Construct, Maintain and Operate An Electric Light, Heat and Power System in the Municipality of Calatrava, Negros Occidental
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp quyền khai thác cho Mrs. Rhode E. Yonzon để xây dựng, lắp đặt, vận hành và duy trì hệ thống điện tại thị xã Calatrava
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติให้สัมปทานแก่ Mrs. Rhode E. Yonzon เพื่อก่อสร้าง ติดตั้ง ดำเนินการ และบำรุงรักษาระบบไฟฟ้าในเทศบาล Calatrava
title.id: Undang-Undang memberikan waralaba kepada Mrs. Rhode E. Yonzon untuk membangun, memasang, mengoperasikan, dan memelihara sistem tenaga listrik di Kotamadya Calatrava
title.ms: Akta memberikan francais kepada Mrs. Rhode E. Yonzon untuk membina, memasang, mengendalikan dan menyelenggara sistem tenaga elektrik di Perbandaran Calatrava

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1953/ra_941_1953.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Subject to the terms and conditions established in Act Numbered Thirty-six hundred and thirty-six, as amended by Commonwealth Act Numbered One hundred and thirty-two, and the provisions of the Constitution, there is granted to Mrs. Rhode E. Yonzon, for a period of twenty-five years from the approval of this Act, the right, privilege, and authority to construct, maintain, and operate an electric light, heat and power system for the purpose of generating and distributing light, heat, and/or power for sale within the Municipality of Calatrava, Province of Negros Occidental.

It is expressly provided that in the event the Government should desire to maintain and operate for itself the system and enterprise herein authorized, the grantee shall surrender her franchise and will turn over to the Government all serviceable equipment therein, at cost, less reasonable depreciation.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, June 20, 1953.
